title: Flutter Developer
description: A roadmap for building production-ready cross-platform mobile apps with Dart, Flutter UI, state management, APIs, testing, and store release.

tree.name: Dart and Flutter Foundations
tree.description: Learn Dart syntax, Flutter project structure, widgets, layout constraints, hot reload, and debugging.

resources.title: Flutter Full Course with Projects (WsCube Tech)

children.name: Dart Language
children.description: Use types, null safety, collections, classes, async/await, streams, packages, and clean project structure.

children.name: Widgets and Layout
children.description: Build responsive screens with rows, columns, stacks, lists, forms, navigation, themes, and custom widgets.

tree.name: App Architecture and Data
tree.description: Structure apps around state, routing, APIs, local storage, validation, error handling, and offline-friendly flows.

children.name: State Management
children.description: Choose Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, or simpler patterns based on app complexity and team needs.

children.name: Networking and Persistence
children.description: Call REST APIs, decode JSON, cache data, store preferences, handle auth tokens, and support offline states.

children.name: Practice: Responsive UI Clone
children.description: Rebuild a real mobile screen with adaptive layouts, theme tokens, form validation, and loading/error states.

tree.name: Testing, Native Features, and Performance
tree.description: Use device APIs, write reliable tests, profile performance, and polish apps for real phones.

children.name: Device Features
children.description: Add camera, location, push notifications, deep links, permissions, platform channels, and background work.

children.name: Performance and Tests
children.description: Write unit/widget/integration tests, profile frames, reduce jank, optimize images, and monitor crashes.

tree.name: Release and Portfolio
tree.description: Prepare builds, store assets, analytics, crash reporting, release notes, and a portfolio-quality demo.

children.name: Store Release Workflow
children.description: Configure signing, flavors, app icons, screenshots, privacy labels, beta testing, and staged rollout.

children.name: Project: Marketplace Mobile App
children.description: Build a Flutter app with auth, product listing, search, cart, offline cache, tests, analytics, and release checklist.
